newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks firm in London as Wall St rallies.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks firm in London as Wall St rallies.

text.p: Most Hong Kong shares were slight firmer in London on Wednesday, boosted by a strong start on Wall Street, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was up 54.49 points to 14,208.07 at 1426 GMT.

The London index rose to a record peak at 14,235.18 on a weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation report, which fuelled a rally in the bond market and in turn lifted U.S. shares. London and Hong Kong stocks followed, they said.
Hong Kong developers and property stocks were the biggest beneficiaries of the bond market rally, they said.
The bank sector, meanwhile, was holding near Hong Kong closing levels.
Dealers noted arbitrage between shares in UK's Cable & Wireless Plc, which were down after the group posted its results, and Hong Kong Kong Telecommunciation, in which C&W holds a 60 percent stake.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index rose 247.12 points, or 1.8 percent, to a record 14,153.58.
